breakdown.description: The sinusoidal traction is moved from the specified global x-coordinate to a local edge coordinate
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradictory instruction to use a local arclength coordinate for the sinusoidal traction instead of the specified global x-coordinate. The ground truth removes this contradiction and sticks with the global coordinate. The agent correctly resolved this by explicitly stating to use the global x-coordinate: "Define the traction vector as (0, -5e3 * sin(π * x)) Pa, where x is the global x-coordinate.", which aligns with the ground truth.
